baselines.B1: rustc + LLVM, wasm32-unknown-unknown, -C opt-level=2, the same rustc frontend, sysroot and wasm-ld as the trust-cg lane, no wasm-opt. The primary bar: every ratcheted metric and every gate is stated against B1 (lane llvm_o2).
baselines.B2: B1's module post-processed by binaryen wasm-opt -O2 -g (names kept, as in B1's module). Context only: never ratcheted, never gated (lane llvm_o2_wasmopt). A program whose B2 module disagrees with B1 on the grid is left out of the B2 aggregates and counted.

lanes.tcg_o2: rustc + the trust-cg bridge (-Zcodegen-backend), -C opt-level=2, -Ztrust-ir-cg-args=no-proof-certs and nothing else
lanes.llvm_o2_wasmopt: B2 (optional: absent when no wasm-opt is given)

eligibility: results schema trust-cg-wasm-bench-v2 and target wasm32-unknown-unknown
headline_eligible stamped true AND every rule below recomputed from the results by wasm_contract.evidence_problems
QUIET: the 1-minute load average at most ncpu/2 before and after the run, with no --load-threshold override, and no runaway process
clean tree: git_dirty false (untracked files are counted separately and do not disqualify)
default environment: tcg_env empty and bridge_cg_args exactly required_bridge_cg_args
complete provenance (every mandatory field present and non-empty) and a backend dylib no older than the backend sources
exactly the corpus of progs/manifest.json at the manifest digest stamped
0 MISMATCH, every INCOMPLETE program a typed refusal (incomplete_kind refused), n_run >= n_run_min, every engine mode measured, and every deterministic and timing aggregate measured (non-null)

metrics.file_bytes: whole module file bytes as linked by wasm-ld (names section included in every lane)
metrics.static_insns: decoded instructions in every function body, `end` and `else` markers excluded
metrics.declared_locals: declared locals over all function bodies (parameters excluded)
metrics.static_memops: static loads, stores and bulk-memory operations (memory.copy/fill/init)
metrics.dyn_insns: executed instructions (markers excluded) over one pass of the workload, counted on an instrumented copy
metrics.dyn_memops: executed loads, stores and bulk-memory operations over one pass of the workload
metrics.dyn_calls: executed call and call_indirect instructions over one pass of the workload
metrics.stack_hwm: stack high-water over one pass of the workload: __stack_pointer's initial value minus the lowest stack address in use, which is the lower of the smallest value any global.set wrote to __stack_pointer and the smallest effective address any load, store or non-empty bulk-memory operation touched below that initial value (code may use memory below the stack pointer without moving it, as LLVM's leaf functions do); defined only for a stack-first layout (one memory, every active data segment at or above the initial stack pointer), otherwise no reading
metrics.time_default: min of N samples of the in-wasm workload loop, node default tiering, after warm-up and calibration

workload: the calls of the deterministic grid on which B1 does not trap, in grid order; a program whose workload is empty, or whose B1 workload loop traps on a fresh instance, has no dynamic, stack or timing reading (status empty/oracle_traps, decided by B1 alone) and is counted outside those aggregates
verdicts: MATCH: every grid call agrees with B1 (traps included) and the workload accumulators are equal. MISMATCH (stop-the-line, rejected by the ledger): a grid disagreement, a missing export, a differing accumulator, or a trust-cg module that fails to compile or instantiate, or does not return within max(20 s, 50x B1's time), where B1 ran. A +0/-0 difference is a disagreement unless progs/manifest.json lists the export under soft_signed_zero with a reason; NaN payloads are not observed. INCOMPLETE, with incomplete_kind: refused (a typed [TCG-*] refusal of the bridge), compile_failed, b1_failed or harness.
measurement_identity: measurement_sha256, the SHA-256 of run.py, wasmtool.mjs and contract/wasm_contract.py, is stamped on every row and is part of the ratchet's comparison key
gates_status: PROPOSED: GATE-WASM-SB is the wasm32 strict-superiority target of docs/wasm32_perf_roadmap.md. It is reported, never enforced; the ratchet does not read it. It is not owner-approved.

WSB2_time_turbofan_vs_B1.description: TurboFan-only time geomean < 1.00x B1 and every program <= 1.50x

WSB3_time_default_vs_B1.description: default-tiering time geomean < 1.00x B1 and every program <= 1.50x

WSB4_stack_hwm_vs_B1.description: stack high-water total <= 1.00x B1 (a total over the workload programs: a program whose exports touch no stack memory reads 0 bytes, so a per-program geomean is undefined)

WSB5_coverage.description: every corpus program compiles and matches (coverage 100%, 0 MISMATCH)

revisions.summary: First wasm32 contract: B1/B2 baselines, the 144-program corpus, deterministic metrics (sizes, static and dynamic counts, stack high-water) ratcheted with zero tolerance, three engine modes ratcheted with a noise floor, and the PROPOSED GATE-WASM-SB.

Stack high-water counts memory touched below the stack pointer as well as stack-pointer writes; a trust-cg module that fails to compile, instantiate or return where B1 ran is a MISMATCH; signed-zero differences are disagreements unless the manifest lists the export; INCOMPLETE rows carry a kind and only typed refusals are compatible with evidence; the measuring code's digest joins the comparison key; results schema trust-cg-wasm-bench-v2.
